summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Cardiol Therapeutics Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, announcing a virtual Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for June 24, 2026. The filing contains only routine meeting logistics and a standard corporate description. There are no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. The filing is merely a notice of an ordinary annual meeting with no transformative corporate action.
